title: For this purpose only
sub: The same one, everywhere, a series on master and reference data: an oath from India's Charaka Samhita, about two thousand years ago, that what a healer sees in a home stays there; an appeal that takes this year's top students' results, given for teaching; Linh's no to fundraising, written on her alumni record and missed by the student system; each role's purposes written beside its data, from one list; her wishes kept on the person; purposes as tags on the columns, and two policies on the platform that read them; the appeal again; her request to see what the university holds about her, answered from the person; and the same rule in a shop and a hospital.
howto: The film is drawn in watercolour. Each role has its own colour: student teal, alumna green, tutor violet, researcher coral, and the donor role, which the appeal asks Linh to take, magenta. Each role's data sits behind a door, with its purposes on a tag. The person, as the master record, is left as white paper and banded in her roles' colours, and her wishes are a note pinned to her. Cyan edges the technical side, gold the business side.
